title: AI literacy at work
description: A short course for everyone who uses, builds, buys or manages AI systems at work: what AI is, how it fails, how to use it safely, what the AI Act asks, and when to raise a concern.

roles.title: All staff
roles.description: For everyone who uses AI tools at work or works with their results.

roles.title: People building or buying AI
roles.description: For developers, product owners, data teams and purchasers who build, configure, integrate or choose AI systems.

roles.title: Managers
roles.description: For people who lead teams that use AI and decide how the organisation supports AI literacy.
